name: fpl-hsmem
description: ForgePlan Hindsight memory plugin for Claude Code. v3.3.0 — audit pass against the official plugin/skill/subagent docs. ONE version source: plugin.json is canonical and the MCP handshake reads it (three places carried a version and all three disagreed — the handshake string is the only thing that identifies which bundle is loaded, and it was two releases stale); held by a test with a negative control. CORRECTED a false premise this plugin had written down and guarded with CI: `allowed-tools` PRE-APPROVES, it does not restrict — the docs are explicit that every tool remains callable and only `disallowed-tools` removes one, so a wrong pin costs a permission prompt, not a denial. Agent fixes: plugin skills must be referenced as `plugin:skill` (bare names were silently skipped, so the curator started with nothing preloaded); `correct-memory` cannot be preloaded at all because it sets `disable-model-invocation`, so its six-step procedure is inlined in the agent body; the prompt-defense preamble is now the canonical six points verbatim (the paraphrase had dropped exactly the secret-handling and smuggling rules the one agent reading unmasked transcripts needs). Hooks moved to exec form — the shell form with an unquoted path placeholder silently breaks all three hooks for any user whose path contains a space. Four tool descriptions gained the sibling-disambiguation line the other 23 already had; memory_reflect declared readOnlyHint. Session design documents moved out of the shipped plugin. 27 MCP tools, 3 hooks, 9 skills, 1 agent.
